cases.title: creates a new freight forwarder with all required fields filled

steps.data: Logged in and navigated to Service Providers > Freight Forwarders

steps.target: Company Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Contact Name, Telephone Number, Email

steps.expected: "Freight forwarder created successfully." banner is shown

Back on the index (this section redirects to the new record's detail page on success), searching the new company name surfaces a row with the entered name, "{city}, {country}" location, and contact name

riskNotes: Unlike Suppliers/Customs Brokers, a successful create redirects to the new record's own detail page rather than staying on the index — verified live, see project_conventions.md.

cases.title: shows a validation error when Company Name is left blank

steps.target: all required fields except Company Name

steps.expected: "The company name field is required." validation banner is shown; nothing is created

cases.title: shows a validation error when City is left blank

steps.expected: "The city field is required." validation banner is shown; nothing is created

riskNotes: Unlike Suppliers (where a blank City 500s with a raw debug page), this field fails gracefully here — verified live before writing this test, see project_conventions.md.
